svg.text: A mel filterbank: 10 triangle filters, 16 kHz, n_fft = 400 (201 bins, 40 Hz apart)
12 points, equally spaced in mel (Slaney scale), map to Hz points that spread out above 1000 Hz.
(a) Peak height 1 (norm = None): neighbor triangles add to 1 between two centers
(b) Slaney area normalization (librosa default): peak height = 2 / (filter width in Hz)
frequency (Hz). Wide filters get low peaks, so every triangle has area 1.
